subject: Ensino Religioso
description_pt: Identificar elementos da tradição oral nas culturas e religiosidades indígenas, afro-brasileiras, ciganas, entre outras.

components.description_pt: Identificar elementos da tradição oral nas culturas e práticas religiosas indígenas
components.description_en: Identify elements of oral tradition in Indigenous religious cultures and practices
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how different cultures portray similar topics in myths and traditional literature

components.description_pt: Identificar elementos da tradição oral nas práticas religiosas afro-brasileiras e ciganas
components.description_en: Identify elements of oral tradition in Afro-Brazilian and Roma religious practices
components.cc_component_description: Identify cultural elements in fables and folktales from diverse traditions

components.description_pt: Reconhecer a tradição oral como característica comum em grupos culturais e religiosos diversos
components.description_en: Recognize the presence of oral tradition as a common feature across diverse cultural and religious groups
components.cc_component_description: Contemplate ideas and perspectives from diverse cultural origins including bilingual peers

cc_matches.description: Recount stories, including fables and folktales from diverse cultures, and determine their central message, lesson, or moral.

Compare and contrast the treatment of similar themes and topics (e.g., opposition of good and evil) and patterns of events (e.g., the quest) in stories, myths, and traditional literature from different cultures.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán interpretar relatos para...
* detectar problemas y situaciones del mundo real
* experimentar emociones y sentimientos sin generar conflicto
* contemplar ideas y perspectivas de una variedad de orígenes y culturas, incluso de otros estudiantes bi/multilingües
* conectar historias a imágenes y representaciones para ampliar su significado
* preparar ideas para sostener y avanzar un diálogo
* examinar cómo se crea un cierre, un resumen y/o pasos a seguir
